title: NFL eyeing possible schedule change with Sunday night flex in Week 8, but league doesn't have a lot of options

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL eyeing possible schedule change with Sunday night flex in Week 8, but league doesn't have a lot of options
sources.description: With Philadelphia and Washington struggling, the league has until Oct. 20 to make a move, but scheduling conflicts across the Week 8 slate leave few viable replacement options
